LanguageData.NMC_ShadowInvisibility.label: Shadow warp invisibility
LanguageData.NMC_ShadowInvisibility.description: A shadow field or ghost armor cloaks the target. Attacking or taking damage does not end it. Detection can still reveal the target; when revelation ends, it becomes invisible again if the source remains.
LanguageData.NMC_GhostIdentity.label: Shadow guard identity
LanguageData.NMC_GhostIdentity.description: A shadow guard from the Nivarian mothership. Fights independently and cannot be drafted. Invisibility helps her approach enemies, but detection can reveal her. Warps out when support ends.
LanguageData.NMC_SeydasConversion.label: Mental allegiance
LanguageData.NMC_SeydasConversion.description: Mind control recruited this unit into the Nivarian survivors. It retains its way of life and behavior, does not become your colonist, and keeps its faction after Seydas's legion leaves.
LanguageData.NMC_LegionIdentity.label: Mothership expedition legion
LanguageData.NMC_LegionIdentity.description: A temporary expedition member sent by Nivarian survivors. Fights and chooses targets independently, cannot be drafted. Members and exclusive equipment warp out after support.
